_comment: Folders that form the CI green gate. The SUT contains real defects, so the
full suite legitimately goes red; the gate is the subset whose expectations
the SUT currently meets, i.e. the regression baseline that must not break.
Section 6 of the brief asks for two sample pipeline runs: one all-passing and
one with a failing case. Commit A = this gate, green. Commit B = move one
defect-revealing folder/case into the gate so the same pipeline goes red.
Verified green against the seeded SUT on the scaffold smoke run.
Re-verify after each batch of new test cases and update this list.
